sources.description: Original input MP3 audio of 江语晨《最后一页》.
Decoded PCM WAV from the original MP3.
Separated lead vocal stem from MelBand Roformer.
Separated instrumental accompaniment stem from MelBand Roformer.
Whisper large-v3-turbo ASR observation on the separated vocal stem.
GAME ONNX note event boundary and pitch MIDI observation on the separated vocal stem.
Continuous FCPE F0 trajectory observation on the separated vocal stem.
Continuous RMVPE F0 trajectory observation on the separated vocal stem.
HubertFA forced alignment word and phoneme intervals across all 38 lyrical phrases.
Agent-authored baseline score.ustx for YousaV1.65c across 38 musical phrases.
Exported baseline native RenderPhrase 5-tick pitch grid from OpenUtau Core.
Exported baseline native RenderPhrase phoneme clock and ownership mapping from OpenUtau Core.
Environment and SHA256 provenance receipt for baseline native exports.
